title: Jamie Foxx Drops Cardi B Bombshell
htmlContent:
Jamie Foxx went to Cardi B's birthday bash and was not treated very well at all. While Jamie was trying to make his way into the celebration, he was stopped by security who would not let him in.

Jamie was obviously confused by why his status could not get him into the party as he exchanged words with security as fans around him cheered for him and his efforts.

Jamie would walk away as security followed. Jamie stated to security: "No, we're not good. I don't give a f***. I love you, but it was too much. It's too much."

It looks like Cardi forgot to put Jamie on the list.
